title: A value set on a flow mapping key that has none is written after a colon
notes: In a flow mapping a key may stand alone and then has the null value (production 145, yaml-test-suite 4ABK and 8KB6). Setting its value writes `: ` and the value after the key; the text of the key and everything else stays. The single space after the colon is a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend wrote `b2`, joining the value to the key.
